items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: So Benny took me and Stan Getz and Buck Clayton and George Duvivier and Gene Krupa, Buck Clayton, out to do the soundtrack.

ctx.x: Is that, what’s it like to do a film like that, is it you sit around and wait a lot?

Well, Benny, I was working with Benny around New York in some small combo kinds of things like at Basin Street West. Teddy Wilson was playing with him at the time and Paul Quinchette, Ruby Braff, and he had, I had just signed on as CBS as a staff musician there and Benny asked me if I’d like to go to California to do a soundtrack for “The Benny Goodman Story.” And I really wanted to do it, so I went and got a release from the CBS and I never had a steady job after that, that was the last steady job ever, which is…
couple of weeks. We just pretended to be playing because we’d already made the soundtrack.
